subject: Signer authority mismatch — portal signatory vs MSA signatory
messages:
From: Ana Rivera <ana.rivera@skybridge-health.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@skybridge-health.com
Date: 2027-06-26T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Portal onboarding — signer list vs signed MSA

Hi Markus / Jonas,

Quick flag from our side as we try to finish the Ariba enrollment: our portal (Skybridge vendor tenant) currently lists two people as the "authorized signer" on PO acceptance (Kristen Liu, Procurement Lead & Rob Dawson, CFO). The executed MSA we uploaded to your portal shows Rob Dawson as the sole signatory for agreements; Kristen is an operational PO approver only.

Our procurement team is worried that when we submit the first order form (PO), the portal will require Kristen to counter-sign the order form and the DocuSign flow will stall because she is not on the MSA signature page. That mismatch will break our PO-to-AR matching and delay the first shipment.

Attached: Skybridge_Signer_List.pdf (export from our vendor admin)

Can you confirm what metadata the Redwood portal uses to map "signer" vs "approver" on order forms and whether we need to amend our MSA or update portal metadata? If it helps, we can share a PO template.

Thanks — want to avoid a hold on ship week.

Best,
Ana Rivera
Director, Vendor Operations
Skybridge Health
[Attachment: Skybridge_Signer_List.pdf (PDF)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-26T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — signer list vs signed MSA

Ana — thanks for the heads up.

Short answer: it's usually a metadata mapping issue on our side (the portal has a separate PO-signer attribute and a contract-signatory attribute). We need to make sure your tenant's "PO signer" role doesn't get promoted to "contract signatory" during enrollment.

Next steps I propose (quick):
- Kimberly: can you confirm whether the current executed MSA explicitly limits signatory authority to Rob Dawson? If not, please call out the clause we should rely on.
- Jonas: ops to verify tenant metadata (Kristen vs Rob) and hold provisioning if a change is required.
- Ana: please attach the PO template so ops can simulate a PO flow.

If we can agree on which side to adjust (portal metadata vs MSA amendment) today, ops can lock the enrollment and we can avoid a downstream DocuSign loop.

Markus
VP, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — signer list vs signed MSA

Thanks Markus / Ana — looping in legal notes below.

I reviewed the executed MSA that Skybridge uploaded. Key points:
1) Signature page: Rob Dawson is the executing signatory for Skybridge. There is no explicit delegation clause in the MSA authorizing Kristen to sign agreements on behalf of Skybridge.
2) Order Form flow: our standard platform treats the entity's "designated contract signer" (captured at tenant creation) as the authority for any agreement that binds the MSA. PO acceptance in Ariba/portal is considered an acceptance of an Order Form which, by our terms, may modify fees and SOW references but is bound to the MSA.

Options (pros and cons):
- Option A (portal metadata change): Update tenant metadata to mark Kristen as "PO approver" only and keep Rob as "contract_signer". This avoids changing the MSA, faster for ops, but requires a tenant-level flag and a one-time admin confirmation from Skybridge.
- Option B (MSA amendment): Execute a one-page addendum naming Kristen as an authorized agent for Order Forms. This gives legal clarity but adds DocuSign steps and may delay onboarding by 3–5 business days.

I recommend Option A unless Skybridge needs a legal delegation on file. If we do Option A we should also:
- Add an enrollment checklist item that logs the admin confirmation (screenshot/attestation).
- Capture the PO signer mapping in the enrollment ticket and attach to the MSA folder for audit.

Attaching a short ops/legal note on the portal signatory mapping process: portal-signature-process.docx

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_redline_v3.docx (Word)] [Attachment: portal-signature-process.docx (Word)]

Attaching our PO template so you can test (PO_template.csv). Also happy to take the DocuSign link if you still prefer the amendment route.
